implementation: A twenty-second unmerged LibreCAD patch starts a private selected-source callback capture immediately before each DWG read, after metadata clear, and seals it only after successful AC1024 import with complete nonconflicting frame coverage and successful dictionary/sort observation capture. The relevant later callback additions and source-version changes invalidate the seal; clear and failed imports leave it unset. The seal is correlation context only and is not used by the exporter.
validation: A C++17 -Werror source-callback harness read the tracked title fixture and checked that one successful session seals and both the dictionary and SORTENTSTABLE source verifiers match. Wrong/restored version, duplicate later membership, clear and failed completion invalidate the seal; new successful imports reseal.

The patch applies in order after the first 21 patches; the macro-excluded source compiles against the older bundled codec. Source-release inventory and 18 refusal controls pass with 1214 files; the 721-input implementation digest is unchanged.

The installed-codec LibreCAD application rebuilt and all three focused CTests passed (1.18 seconds). The dictionary and optional title-fixture sort importer cases plus snapshot case passed 68 assertions, including seal, version change, failed open and reimport.
limits: The seal records a successfully finalized selected-callback session. It is not source authentication, an immutable generation identifier across copied documents, a universal edit detector, proof of class coverage or complete inbound references, graph closure, output permission, native semantic parity or a support claim. Per-record comparison and all downstream graph/output gates remain mandatory.
